headline: Qatar Grand Prix preview: three points split Hamilton, Russell, and Norris as the grid arrives in Lusail
whyCareReason: After Las Vegas, Formula 1 returns to three practices and Sunday's 57-lap night race with P3 in both championships on a knife-edge.
teaser: Round 22 heads to Lusail (27-29 Nov) with a standard weekend, no F1 sprint. Hamilton 267, Russell and Norris 264, Verstappen 304.
story:
Formula 1 trades Las Vegas neon for the floodlights of Lusail International Circuit as Round 22 of the 2026 World Championship unfolds in Qatar from Friday, 27 November through Sunday, 29 November.

Unlike previous seasons, the 2026 Qatar Grand Prix runs under the standard weekend format with three practice sessions, Saturday qualifying (21:00 AST), and a 57-lap Grand Prix on Sunday night (19:00 AST). Practice opens on Friday with FP1 at 16:30 local time and night practice FP2 at 20:00.

Although Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli has wrapped up the Drivers crown (402 pts) and Mercedes own the Constructors title (666 pts), intense scraps remain live. Max Verstappen sits comfortably second on 304 points following his Vegas triumph, while just three points divide Lewis Hamilton (267) from George Russell and Lando Norris (264 apiece). Meanwhile, McLaren (431) sit just nine points shy of Red Bull (440) for third in Constructors.
stakes: Just two Grands Prix remain (Qatar and Abu Dhabi) to settle Drivers P3 through P5 and the $10M Constructors battle between Red Bull and McLaren.
rivalryAngle: After Norris and Piastri stormed the Vegas podium, McLaren carry huge high-downforce momentum into Lusail fast sweepers.
funFacts: Qatar 2026 follows the traditional three-practice format with no Formula 1 sprint race.
Grand Prix lights out is Sunday, 29 November at 19:00 local AST (16:00 UTC) for 57 laps.
Ferrari (517) hold a 77-point lead over Red Bull (440), who lead McLaren (431) by 9 points.
